card.name: Last letter of lab abbreviations ALC, ALP
card.fires_on: The final letter C or P that completes the lab abbreviations ALC (absolute lymphocyte count) and ALP (alkaline phosphatase), after the letters AL. It appears in lab thresholds and monitoring sections.
